errors.evidence: The description states that the balance (Saldo) begins at about -10 billion USD in 2020, but the first bar on the chart is at approximately -65 billion USD (calculated from Imports ~200 and Exports ~135 on the left scale).

errors.text_span: fällt bis Mitte 2020 auf etwa -60 Mrd. US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The description claims the balance falls to -60 billion USD by mid-2020. In fact, the balance rises (the deficit shrinks) to approximately -50 billion USD during this period. Both the trend (falling vs. rising) and the value are incorrect.

errors.text_span: erreicht Ende 2023 einen Wert von etwa -180 Mrd. US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The description states the final balance value at the end of 2023 is approximately -180 billion USD. However, based on the line data (Imports ~340, Exports ~180, Saldo = 180-340 = -160), the value is closer to -160 billion USD. The error of 20 billion USD is significant.
